neo_rows.title: Later ideology, theology and cosmological rearticulation
neo_rows.description: How preverbal felt care and scarcity are later mediated through actually accessible concepts, historical institutions, language and activity; no predetermined doctrine.

review_corrections: Object-mediated social activity and later available language/institutional participation may produce conceptual reinterpretation; no ideological inevitability or baby-with-adult-theology backdating.
Lahire's plurality is contingent, not a universal default; no unobserved latent orientations without formation evidence.
Later meaning can change actor's present action only via qualified witnessed SCI05/CAN008/CAN011 internal/ordinary activity, not because narrative generated plausible prose.
A false explanatory belief about infancy may be actor-owned ADP017 proposition without ADP016 remembered positive infant event.

S48 has exactly one prospective candidate and current-source/SCI05 refusal: transport is not full user-settled 3–5 resolution.
